records.text: Owens accused Farnsworth of lying to her, stating that he apparently knew how to send footage and used a Google link on September 10 despite telling her eight days later that he feared Google would hack him.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Actually, on the very day of the assassination, Terrell (Terrell Farnsworth) apparently did know how to send footage and he chose to do that via. A Google link. He used the very company that he would then tell me eight days later he was afraid was going to hack him. That makes Terrell (Terrell Farnsworth) a liar.

verification.notes: Verified that Owens made the accusation with the stated rationale. In context she contrasts Farnsworth's alleged September 10 Google Drive delivery with what she says he told her eight days later about fearing a Google hack, then explicitly calls him a liar. The source proves the accusation and its qualifiers, not the independently unrecorded content of the private call.

records.text: In his 1102 statement, Farnsworth said that on September 10 he gave the Utah State Bureau of Investigation four videos through Google Drive and that they truly and correctly represented what occurred at UVU.
records.speaker: Terryl Farnsworth

appearances.snippet: That day on September 10th, I provided SBI with four videos through a Google Drive, and then you see the link, and he tells you what those videos are labeled. Okay. And then he says these videos were taken by me and my team at the U of U event on September 10th, 2025. These videos, as they were provided to SBI, are a true and correct representation of what took place at UVU.

verification.notes: The source appearance shows Owens reading the 1102 passage that Farnsworth provided SBI four videos through Google Drive on September 10 and represented them as a true and correct record of what occurred at UVU. This verifies the quoted contents of the displayed statement, not an independent forensic assessment of the videos.
